papers.title: 3D convolutional neural network based multi-modal data fusion for fatigue life prediction of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Additive Manufacturing and Intelligent Equipment Research Institute, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai 200237, China

corresponding_authors.name: Haijie Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical and Power Engineering, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai 200237, China

corresponding_authors.name: Bo Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Manufacturing and Intelligent Equipment Research Institute, East China University of Science and Technology, Shanghai 200237, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳寿命预测，采用3D CNN融合多模态数据，与研究方向高度契合。
llm.why_not_core: 模型验证完全基于文献数据，未自主进行Ti-6Al-4V疲劳试验。

summary_zh.motivation: 利用多模态数据提高增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳寿命预测精度
summary_zh.method: 提出3D卷积神经网络融合多种数据模态进行疲劳寿命预测
summary_zh.result: 模型能准确预测不同工艺条件下Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳寿命
summary_zh.validation: 基于文献实验数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve fatigue life prediction accuracy for additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V by integrating multi-modal data.
summary_en.method: A 3D convolutional neural network is used to fuse multiple data modalities for fatigue life prediction.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts fatigue life for Ti-6Al-4V under various processing conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using experimental fatigue data from literature.

papers.title: A defect-based model for fatigue life prediction of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of Vibration and Control of Aero-Propulsion System of Ministry of Education, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Liyang Xie
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Vibration and Control of Aero-Propulsion System of Ministry of Education, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳寿命预测，属于L1层关注的核心内容。
llm.why_not_core: The paper is predominantly modeling; although validated, it does not report new experimental data or emphasize as-built mechanical properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳寿命预测，提出基于缺陷的模型。
summary_zh.method: 通过考虑缺陷特征（尺寸、位置、形态）建立疲劳寿命预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 该模型能够有效预测不同缺陷状态下的疲劳寿命，与实验数据吻合良好。
summary_zh.validation: 利用已有的实验疲劳数据验证模型预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a defect-based fatigue life prediction model specifically for additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloys.
summary_en.method: A model incorporating defect characteristics such as size, location, and morphology is established to predict fatigue life.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts fatigue life under various defect conditions, showing good agreement with experimental data.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated against existing experimental fatigue data from literature or own tests.

papers.title: Experimental investigation of short fatigue crack propagation behavior within and across heat-affected zone in WAAM Ti-6Al-4V
papers.first_author_affiliation: Graduate School of China Academy of Engineering Physics, Beijing 100193, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xuefei Guan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Graduate School of China Academy of Engineering Physics, Beijing 100193, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了WAAM增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的短疲劳裂纹扩展行为，属于L1层基础力学与疲劳特性研究。
llm.why_not_core: No overall S-N fatigue life data or standard tensile properties; focuses solely on short crack propagation within and across heat-affected zone.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究WAAM Ti-6Al-4V中短疲劳裂纹在热影响区内部和跨区域的扩展行为。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验疲劳试验结合显微观察监测裂纹扩展。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了热影响区对短裂纹扩展路径和速率的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 采用机械疲劳测试与断口显微分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the short fatigue crack propagation behavior within and across the heat-affected zone in WAAM Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental fatigue tests with in-situ or post-mortem microscopy to track crack growth.
summary_en.result: Found distinct crack propagation characteristics influenced by the heat-affected zone microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Validated through mechanical fatigue testing and fractographic analysis.
